page.title: What is PropertyList?
page.body:
What is PropertyList?


PropertyList.es is Andalucía’s first free Smart MLS and CRM ecosystem. Designed to replace traditional, expensive subscription portals, it operates as an inclusive marketplace where the core tools of the real estate trade are free forever.

At its core, PropertyList is the first-ever fusion of MLS efficiency and public property portal visibility. It provides a transparent, collaborative infrastructure that empowers a verified network of thousands of estate agents to seamlessly share a live database of properties.


The Smart Infrastructure More than just a static property database, PropertyList serves as the complete digital headquarters for modern property professionals:

  • Free Collaborative Core: Agents and developers receive unlimited property uploads, unlimited staff accounts, and a built-in automated CRM to manage clients and close deals without fixed monthly overheads.
  • AI Utility Agents: The platform equips professionals with next-generation tools, including the AI Property Research Agent (for generating professional Comparative Market Analysis reports in minutes) and the Renovation Agent (for creating realistic "before & after" visualisations with itemised market-rate cost breakdowns) and much more. 
  • Democratised Visibility: Every user automatically receives a free, branded MicroSite with built-in lead capture. For agencies, the platform offers an XML Sync to instantly import the entire MLS database to their own website.
  • A Connected Ecosystem: Integration grants instant access to a 3,000+ member WhatsApp co-broking community and a social media network of over 40,000 members.

Our Mission We are on a mission to revolutionise the housing market by seamlessly connecting Buyers, Renters, Estate Agents, Developers, and Property Services (such as lawyers, builders, and architects) within a single, verified grid. PropertyList is an inclusive space where everyone discovers quality homes, receives unwavering support, and accesses top-rated services.
